w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE REDACTOR! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Chorus Line is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Terms of Service: Read the fine print — find the loophole. Clauses write themselves and unanswered ones auto-accept, the penalties landing unread. Spend turns examining the scroll and you will find the loophole clause that dismisses it outright. (Striking the scroll just gives it more to bill you for.) (Liam lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Anan stared at their hands for a long time today. Something is changing.
They come fast and scared — a family, or what's left of one. "Please. We heard you take people in." Behind them, something worse than weather.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/13/7), with 5 wave-4 fought, 4 contests survived, 5 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 8 · Craft 6 · Talk 10 · Explore 28 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Hannah Kim ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
